description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police officer in his late 30s. He has a clean-shaven face and short, neat black hair. He is wearing a formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, official badges on the chest, and matching dark blue trousers. He is standing upright with a professional and authoritative posture.

FULL BODY. An elderly Malaysian woman in her late 60s with a kind, weathered face. She is wearing a traditional light blue Baju Kurung with a modest floral pattern and a matching cream-colored tudung (headscarf). She wears simple leather sandals. Her figure is slightly hunched, reflecting her retired status.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette made of dark, glitchy digital noise. The figure has no facial features. It wears a translucent, holographic business suit overlay to mimic a professional appearance. One arm glows with a faint, pulsing red light to distinguish it as a predatory entity.
